free_text: 54 y/o male with PSA 5.9 and PI-RADS 5 following a negative biopsy warrants repeat targeted biopsy per EAU guidelines. The rising PSA velocity of 0.97 ng/mL/yr increases suspicion despite prior negative sampling. Low PSA density supports a cautious approach, but the PI-RADS 5 finding dictates further tissue sampling.
